notes:
Summary: Mid-market commerce platform; product teams (search + support) ran Hosted API first, now moving toward Dedicated. Team composition: Head of Product (Sofie Kim), Platform Eng (Marco Ruiz), Data Science (Priya Shah).

POC / Technical: Hosted trial was used to capture realistic QPS and token mix; devs instrumented request meta and sample prompts. Key numbers from trial: ~30k sessions in 2 weeks, avg tokens/session 180, peak QPS 40, average latency 230ms on hosted (few timeouts during bursts). They want Dedicated for predictable unit economics and VPC controls.

Capacity ask: SE requested guidance on node sizing for 25-50 QPS with mixed token lengths. Customer prefers to size conservatively (2 nodes) then auto-scale/burst. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and KV prefix caching to reduce token spend on product-search.

Security / Compliance: Requires SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 1 year, KMS integration for key control, and EU data residency for EU customers. Security has started questionnaire; missing items: proof of SOC2 plus details on KMS flow (we provided drive://redwood/security/echomeridian-security-answers.pdf).

Commercial / Pricing: Cost sensitivity moderate — they want predictable committed pricing for 3-6 months with overage protection. Asking for examples of Dedicated pricing for node counts + a modeled monthly cost given their token forecast.

Quotes & asks from calls: "If we can get a predictable monthly number and a clear rollback to hosted API during spikes, we can sign in April" — Sofie Kim.

Next steps: 1) Run capacity-sizing workshop w/ infra + provide detailed cost model (action: Arjun to deliver by 2026-03-12). 2) Spin up 2-node Dedicated POC (2-week, telemetry + SLOs). 3) SE to prepare sample rollout plan (canary + auto-fallback).
